platform_name: noble-post-quantum: Auditable & minimal JS implementation of public-key post-quantum cryptography
product_brief: Auditable & minimal JS implementation of public-key post-quantum cryptography.
pqc_capability_description: Implements ML-KEM (Kyber), ML-DSA (Dilithium), SLH-DSA (SPHINCS+), and Falcon Round 3. Includes hybrid algorithms combining PQC with classic ECC (X25519, P-256, P-384). Based on FIPS-203, FIPS-204, and FIPS-205 standards.
crypto_primitives: ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, Falcon, X25519, P-256, P-384, SHA2, SHA3, SHAKE, HKDF-SHA256
key_management_model: Software-based key generation and encapsulation/signing within the JS runtime; no external HSM or MPC mentioned.
fips_validated: No (Implements algorithms defined in FIPS-203, FIPS-204, FIPS-205, but library itself is not stated as FIPS validated)
primary_platforms: Node.js, Deno, Browsers, React Native (with polyfill)
implementation_attack_surface: No protection against side-channel attacks; vulnerable to timing attacks.
testing_&_validation_methods: Passes published Round 3 KATs for Falcon; includes internal tests for correctness.
supply_chain_&_vendor_risk: Minimal dependencies (noble-hashes, noble-curves); PGP-signed commits; transparent NPM builds; pinned dependencies.
deployment_&_migration_complexity: Tree-shakeable; supports hybrid algorithms for gradual migration; old Kyber version not provided (incompatible).

platform_name: ML-DSA-OSH: open-source hardware implementation of ML-DSA (KU Leuven-COSIC)
product_brief: Open-source hardware implementation of ML-DSA by KU Leuven-COSIC.
